crossRefs.note: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by…
“Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff…
When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again…
They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave…
For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply…

translations.web: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.
translations.bsb: You are to weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day, and you are to eat it at set times.
translations.kjv: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat
translations.asv: And thy food which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
